answer: At daybreak the journeyman dyer overcasts the cut edge so it will not fray, trimming the threads close after the stitch. Warp loom maker thread writ guards the overcasting: a writ loom makers sign after loom shop audits. The inlet sets the overcasting going, the lotus brings the edge home, the violet rests the stitches. A false proof costs 293 false casts and 293 false overcastings.
